title: push/pop were ignored, so a popped assertion stayed a premise

reproducer.claim: the problem is unsatisfiable (the certificate refutes it)

twin.claim: unsatisfiable, with a correct refutation, and it contains the reproducer's construct: a scope pushed, given an assertion and popped, then p and (not p) asserted at the base level: the refutation uses only the base assertions

witness.input: the reproducer's problem script, with (get-model) after every check-sat
witness.observed: sat at every check, with a model under which an independent evaluator (smt_model_check in the runner) finds every assertion and assumption in scope true

no_control: Clean main refuses any problem with push or pop ('push' is not supported: a problem must be a single query), the twin included; clean-external is the only verifier of an SMT entry
